home.introSignedOut: Sign in or create an account to manage your organisation and your team.
home.noOrgs: You do not belong to any organisation yet.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Use
signup.checkEmailBody: If this email address can be used, we have sent it a link. Open the link to finish. Look in your spam folder too.

login.title: Sign in
login.linkInvalid: That link did not work. It may have expired. Please sign in, or ask for a new link.

mfa.enrolWhy: Your role needs a second step when you sign in. Use an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.scan: 1. Scan this picture with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app:
mfa.enterCode: 2. Type the 6-digit code shown in the app.
mfa.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the code it shows.

account.title: My account
account.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
account.mfaOn: On. Your account is protected with an authenticator app.

orgs.title: Your organisations
orgs.none: You do not belong to any organisation yet.
orgs.typePartnerHint: Owners of partner organisations must use an authenticator app.
orgs.nameHint: 2 to 160 characters. Buyers can use their own name.

members.title: Team and invitations
members.name: Name
members.readOnly: You can see the team. Your role cannot change it.

admin.usersIntro: People who can run MITRA. Every change is written to the audit log.
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
admin.auditIntro: The latest 200 entries you are allowed to see. This list is read-only.

invite.title: You have been invited
invite.signedOutHint: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to, then you will join automatically. New here? Create an account with that same email address.
invite.failedTitle: We could not use this invitation
invite.failedHint: Check that you are signed in with the email address that received the invitation.
invite.signOut: Sign out and use another account

legal.draftBanner: DRAFT. This text has not been reviewed by a lawyer and is not final.
legal.termsBody: These terms are a placeholder. The final terms will explain how you may use MITRA, what we expect from you and what you can expect from us.
legal.privacyBody: This notice is a placeholder. The final notice will explain what personal data we keep, why we keep it, how long, and how you can ask us to change or delete it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: We could not find that page.

invite.subject: You are invited to join MITRA
invite.intro: You have been invited to join the organisation {org} on MITRA.
invite.expires: The link works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.ignore: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.conflict: That cannot be done right now.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.last_owner: An organisation must always keep at least one owner.
errors.invalid_invitation: This invitation is not valid. It may be used, cancelled, expired or meant for another email address.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member.
errors.invalid_name: Please type a name (2 to 160 characters; your own name up to 120).
errors.org_limit_reached: You have reached the limit for creating organisations.
errors.invalid_role: That role cannot be used here.
errors.invalid_email: Please type a valid email address.
errors.cannot_grant_above_own_role: You cannot give a role higher than your own.
errors.target_outranks_actor: You cannot change someone with a role equal to or higher than yours.
errors.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.invitation_not_pending: This invitation is no longer waiting.
errors.role_not_allowed_for_org_type: That role does not fit this type of organisation.
errors.mitra_org_cannot_be_suspended: The MITRA administration cannot be suspended.
errors.unknown_action: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unknown_user: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.details_too_large: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.already_bootstrapped: The first administrator has already been set up.
errors.user_not_found_or_unconfirmed: That user was not found or has not confirmed their email.
errors.password_weak: Use at least 10 characters, with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
errors.password_same: Please choose a password you have not used just now.
errors.terms_required: Please accept both the Terms of Use and the Privacy Notice.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not right. Please try again.
errors.login_failed: Email or password is incorrect. If you just created your account, confirm your email first.
errors.email_failed: The invitation was saved but the email could not be sent. Cancel it and try again.
errors.consent_required: Please accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Notice first (My account).
errors.invalid_consent: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_throttle: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.last_admin: There must always be at least one super administrator.
errors.mfa_required: This change needs your authenticator code first.

consent.title: Review and accept terms and privacy
consent.intro: To create an organisation or accept an invitation, please accept the current Terms of Use and Privacy Notice (version 2026-07).

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Type your email address. If we can use it, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email address can be used, we have sent a link. Check your inbox and your spam folder.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: At least 10 characters, with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
reset.noSession: This link did not work or has expired.
